name: mailrust
description: Self-hosted email platform: a sending API (like Resend) and a newsletter app (like beehiiv), on one Rust engine that sends through your own Amazon SES. Guards your SES reputation, and your AI can run it over MCP.

paragraphs: Self-hosted email platform with two doors: a sending API (like Resend) and a newsletter app (like beehiiv). One Rust engine sends everything through your own Amazon SES account.
features: Sending API — POST /emails, batch, scheduled send, idempotency keys, attachments, webhooks, open/click tracking.
Safe for many accounts — each account is its own SES tenant with its own block list, and Mailrust pauses an account itself when bounces go over 2% or complaints over 0.08%.

Smart sending — "priority": "urgent" | "normal" | "bulk" puts login codes ahead of newsletters. The send rate follows your SES limits, a hit on the SES daily cap pauses sending instead of failing emails, and the last…
Newsletter — subscribers with double opt-in, tags, CSV import, a block editor, sending in growing waves, one-click unsubscribe, per-newsletter reports and a public archive.
Dashboard — magic-link login, teams and invites (owner/member), emails log, API keys, webhooks, domains and suppressions in a Next.js app.
